body.prompt: A wide panoramic handcrafted miniature diorama of Korea as a cozy toy world at golden hour, all landmarks arranged in one low horizontal band along the bottom third: hanok rooftops with warm glowing paper windows, a tiny palace gate, Seoul tower on a small hill, apartment towers with lit windows, a persimmon tree with orange fruit, a little harbor, soft mountains behind. The upper two thirds is a calm warm peach-and-lavender sunset sky with a few soft felt clouds, mostly empty. On the right side, the magpie character flies happily carrying a small brown parcel tied with red string and a red heart tag, red neckerchief fluttering. Tilt-shift, warm nostalgic light. The exact same magpie character from the reference image: glossy black head, cream-white face and belly, big shiny dark-brown eyes, short black beak, dark navy-blue wings, red knotted neckerchief, small brown leather satchel. It does NOT hold a microphone. Cute 3D clay-and-vinyl toy figurine, soft studio light. No text, no letters, no logos.
